text:
Maria: Heads-up: planning a delta swap of private-installer v2.9.1 -> v2.9.2-d17 in the VPC change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Need packaging + release lead ack. TL;DR: small kernel fix + offline metadata bump. Pin image tag private-installer:v2.9.2-d17
Kevin: On it, building shrinkwrap and delta patch now. ETA ~19:40 UTC.
Olivia: Canary plan? how many seeds?
Maria: Canary on 3 staging hosts, then 1 customer mirror for smoke. 30m evaluation (checksums, install logs, health).
Sam: Packaging note: checksum format updated — we'll deliver both sha256 and signed manifest.json. deploybot will validate cosign sig.
deploybot: packaging job #2345 started; artifacts: private-installer:v2.9.2-d17, delta.patch.gz; checksums computed.
Kevin: Pin command (run after manifest upload):
```
./releasectl pin --env=private --image=private-installer:v2.9.2-d17 --manifest=man-v2.9.2.json
```
Olivia: Need rollback trigger defined. If >10% install failures in first 15m OR missing cosign sig, abort and revert pin to v2.9.1. Escalate to @oncall.
Maria: Agreed. Runbook (short): 1) abort canary: `deployctl rollback-image --to=private-installer:v2.9.1` 2) rotate signer if cosign mismatch 3) open incident in #incidents and ping @oncall.
Sam: Heads-up: KMS rotation is scheduled tomorrow AM; I'll validate signature TTL before we push.
deploybot: canary started at 22:00:30 UTC on seeds [stg-01, stg-02, stg-03].
Kevin: stg-01 delta applied: success. logs: 'install OK, service up'.
Kevin: stg-02 failed with 'disk full' during installer. Cleared temp, retrying.
Maria: If any seed fails twice, stop and investigate. Don't promote to customer mirrors until all three green.
deploybot: stg-02 retry OK after cleanup. stg-03 OK. Canary status: 3/3 green @22:07:12 UTC.
Olivia: Telemetry shows minor unpack latency bump but within thresholds. Proceed to mirror smoke.
Sam: Uploading signed manifest + delta to mirror: s3://private-release-mirror/2026-02/d17/manifest.json.sig
Kevin: Initiating limited mirror rollout to mirror-cust-1 (non-prod).
Maria: Reminder: change window ends 23:30 UTC. If any customer mirror fails, we attempt rollforward (repair + re-run delta). Full rollback only for critical installer crash.
Olivia: I'll add rollforward steps to the release notes PR.
Maria: Release notes snippet: 'v2.9.2-d17 — kernel patch delta; signed manifest; canary pass; mirror smoke initiated. Rollback policy: restore to v2.9.1 on critical installer crash; otherwise rollforward repairs.'
deploybot: mirror-cust-1 applied delta: OK. Promotion paused for throttling.
Kevin: Tagging release branch: `git tag release/private-v2.9.2-d17 && git push origin --tags`.
Sam: Cosign sig TTL verified: valid until 2026-06-01.
Olivia: PR created for release notes + checklist: [canary pass, signed manifest, checksums uploaded, pin applied, mirror smoke].
Maria: :thumbsup: thanks team. I'll be on standby until 23:45 UTC. Ping me for urgent rollback/rollforward decisions.
